categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in residential and commercial building development, including construction, sale, and leasing of residential buildings and commercial properties. It also undertakes domestic and international civil engineering and water conservancy projects. Subsidiaries focus on construction contracting, asset management, real estate leasing, advertising, and energy technology services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction management techniques including digital 3D architectural drawing, BIM (Building Information Modeling) for precise quantity calculation and schedule control, and ERP systems for integrated resource planning. It emphasizes sustainable building practices aligned with ESG principles and green building trends, using legal and quality-certified materials and third-party verification for construction quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are general consumers purchasing residential units, including owner-occupiers and investors, mainly in the Taichung metropolitan area. The company also serves commercial tenants and government entities through social housing projects. The market focus is on mid to high-end residential properties and commercial real estate in Taiwan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with a strong focus on the Taichung metropolitan area, including districts such as Beitun and Xitun. It also has activities in other major Taiwanese cities but concentrates its land development and sales efforts in central Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, including land acquisition, property development, construction, sales, and leasing. It controls construction through its wholly owned construction subsidiary, ensuring quality and schedule management, and engages in asset management and property leasing downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on dual-brand development targeting different market segments, expanding commercial investment, and enhancing brand value through ESG integration and digital transformation. R&D efforts emphasize digitalization of land and project data, adoption of BIM and ERP systems, and sustainable building technologies. The company also pursues diversification through subsidiaries and aims for IPO of its construction arm.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of residential and commercial real estate properties, including pre-sale and completed units. Additional income streams include construction contracting fees, leasing income from properties, and advertising services. The company also benefits from government contracts for social housing projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the Taiwanese real estate development market, particularly in Taichung, leveraging its strong local brand, land acquisition capabilities, and quality construction management. It differentiates itself through ESG integration, digitalization, and diversified business lines. Competitors include other regional developers and construction firms, but the company maintains a competitive edge via its comprehensive project management and market insight.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported a significant revenue increase to approximately NT$12.75 billion in 2024, a 738% growth from the previous year, driven by completion and sales of major projects. Net profit rose over 600% to NT$2.19 billion. Total assets decreased slightly due to project completion, while equity increased nearly 30%. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with expanding market share in Taichung.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes sustainable, human-centered architectural design integrating ESG principles and green building standards. It offers differentiated products through precise market positioning, quality construction, and comprehensive after-sales service. Digitalization of sales and project management enhances customer experience and operational efficiency, reinforcing brand trust and long-term value creation.
